title: XTRACT white matter tract atlas (standardised tractography protocols), streamlines in TrackVis TRK format
authors: Warrington S, Bryant KL, Khrapitchev AA, et al. (atlas); converted to streamlines and distributed as OSF archives by Jaan Aru (author of the 'yabplot' Python package)
publication: Warrington S, et al. (2020). XTRACT - Standardised protocols for automated tractography in the human and macaque brain. NeuroImage 217:116923.

redistribution.available_from: https://osf.io/7tbjg/ (and the OSF project of the 'yabplot' package)
redistribution.note: The archives are distributed with the MIT licensed 'yabplot' Python package (https://github.com/teanijarv/yabplot). They are redistributed here in unpacked form, unchanged, to make them available to the R packages of this project without depending on a third party file host.
